candidates.name: mem35
candidates.rationale: KV-cache usage reached capacity with preemptions; gpu_memory_utilization 0.25 -> 0.35 adds cache blocks
candidates.expected_effect: preemptions fall; TPOT of long-running requests stabilizes
candidates.expected_cost: less free memory for activations/graphs; may fail to start (recorded as a failed run)

candidates.name: seqs128
candidates.rationale: fewer concurrent sequences (256 -> 128) keep the cache below capacity
candidates.expected_cost: queue wait and TTFT rise; throughput falls

notes: queue_overload can also be a capacity problem: replaying at a lower arrival rate is a workload change, not a configuration change
every candidate is a fresh engine started by llmtrace run; no running server is modified
